remainingLimitations: The advisory unknown/loading and failed-RPC states reproduce in the required byte-identical main.js; an upstream fix and new source commit are needed.

Turkish at 320px has pre-existing document overflow. The stage was 318.4375px wide at x=16 both with the original nowrap rule restored and with it deleted. Pantry text has no overlaps after the fix. Other 17 tested locale/width combinations had no document overflow.
Supplied MCP browser launch failed with Socket path too long; standalone Playwright Chromium was used instead.
WebKit launch failed because required shared libraries were unavailable. Firefox, native 200% zoom, screen readers, physical devices, wallet connection, chain switching and signing were not tested.
Direct browser network/CORS behavior was not validated by the curl-forwarded successful path. The pinned taste probe used direct browser network and saw fallback data.
Existing contrast, casing, tracking, type-size, family-count, glyph and chrome probe findings remain under the preserve-styles-and-text scope.
Hosting/ENS/IPFS publication occurs after submission; this revision supplies the rebuilt dist and makes no claim of a deployed update.
completion: Targeted revision complete; upstream behavior and verification limitations remain listed. Evidence is stored under docs/revision because artifacts/ is reserved for ignored Hardhat compiler output.
